# Keep blank optional opportunity details from creating empty labels

## What & Why
Whitespace-only optional values such as a next action or notes can currently remain truthy and produce blank-looking content in saved opportunity cards. Normalizing these values would keep the queue readable without changing the required-field behavior delivered here.

## Done looks like
- Whitespace-only optional next actions and notes are treated as empty when an opportunity is saved.
- Saved cards show the normal empty-state copy instead of blank labels or gaps.
- Existing non-empty optional values remain intact.
